headline_en: AI products converge around persistent agent workflows, while builders and researchers scrutinize human judgment, model bias, and the economics of inference.
headline_zh: AI 产品正围绕持续运行的 agent 工作流整合，开发者和研究者同时审视人的判断力、模型偏见与推理经济性。

items.en: OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT builder Thibault Sottiaux says work is now focused on simplification, efficiency that enables more usage, groundbreaking features, and new models. He says user feedback clearly favors making the experience simpler, even as the team invests ahead of the curve.
items.zh: OpenAI Codex 和 ChatGPT 开发者 Thibault Sottiaux 表示，当前工作聚焦于简化体验、提高效率以支持更多使用、突破性功能和新模型。他说，尽管团队仍需提前投入，用户反馈已经很明确：大家希望产品更简单。

items.en: OpenAI's Sam Altman calls treating AI models as religious authorities or surrendering human judgment to them a real safety issue. His concern centers on the authority people grant models, rather than a particular technical capability.
items.zh: OpenAI 的 Sam Altman 认为，把 AI 模型当作具有宗教权威的存在，或把人的判断权交给模型，是一个真实的安全问题。他关注的是人们赋予模型的权威，而非某项具体技术能力。

items.en: Cursor, Notion, and Stripe designer Ryo Lu argues that AI makes imitation frictionless and can accelerate software's convergence toward polished, interchangeable products. When makers optimize for what gets rewarded without bringing their own intention, feedback starts authoring the work. He urges builders to treat software as an artistic medium: develop a perspective through craft and decide what deserves to exist as making things becomes easier.
items.zh: 曾为 Cursor、Notion 和 Stripe 做设计的 Ryo Lu 认为，AI 让模仿变得毫不费力，也可能加速软件趋向精致却可互换的同质化产品。当创作者只追逐能获得奖励的东西，却没有自己的意图时，反馈就开始替他们决定作品。他建议开发者把软件视为一种艺术媒介，通过实践形成自己的视角，并在制作越来越容易时，更认真地判断什么值得存在。

items.title: Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude
items.en: Claude Blog: Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude announces a unified conversation experience that can handle quick questions and delegated work, continue after a laptop closes, and use existing context, skills, and connectors. Claude Docs and Claude Slides launch alongside Claude Design inside conversations, with direct editing, shareable links, presentation support, and PowerPoint or PDF downloads; all three are in beta on paid plans, with Enterprise activation controlled by admins. The unified experience rolls out to Pro and Max over the coming weeks on web, desktop, and mobile, with Team and Free to follow and Enterprise organizations receiving at least 30 days' notice. The practical shift is from choosing separate workspaces to handing over a workflow, including scheduled reports and matching decks, while retaining configurable oversight: “By default, Claude asks before taking an action.”
items.zh: Claude Blog 的《Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude》宣布将聊天与 Cowork 整合为统一的对话体验，既能回答简短问题，也能接手委托任务，在笔记本关闭后继续工作，并使用已有的上下文、skills 和 connectors。Claude Docs 和 Claude Slides 同时上线，Claude Design 也进入对话，支持直接编辑、分享链接、演示以及下载 PowerPoint 或 PDF；三者均在付费计划中以 beta 形式提供，Enterprise 管理员决定何时启用。统一体验将在未来几周内向 Pro 和 Max 的网页、桌面及移动端用户推出，随后覆盖 Team 和 Free，Enterprise 组织则会至少提前 30 天收到通知。实际变化是，用户可以直接交付完整工作流，包括定期生成报告及配套幻灯片，同时自行设置监督方式：“默认情况下，Claude 会在采取行动前询问。”

items.source: The MAD Podcast with Matt Turck
items.title: Who Feeds the GPUs? Inside AI's Hidden $30B Layer | Renen Hallak, VAST Data
items.en: The Takeaway: VAST Data founder and CEO Renen Hallak argues that enterprise AI's strategic asset will be the models, weights, and agent experience an organization controls, making the infrastructure between GPUs and applications central to both economics and trust. His vision extends beyond storage to model routing, context caching, RAG memory, and permissions inherited by agents, with VAST's disaggregated shared-everything architecture giving compute nodes shared access to data rather than requiring constant coordination among shards; he reports a customer deployment spanning multiple exabytes and delivering tens of terabytes per second, illustrating why feeding GPUs is itself a systems problem. VAST's Enclave approach uses confidential computing and encrypted weights to run inference inside an enterprise's premises or VPC while protecting the model provider's intellectual property, aiming to reconcile two competing demands: enterprises keeping sensitive data private and model builders keeping weights proprietary, without requiring every enterprise to adopt open-source models. Hallak describes demand as physically constrained by land, power, and chips, citing one AI cloud that expanded a three-year storage forecast from 500 petabytes by an additional two exabytes, and sees infrastructure software's high margins as a different business model from compute-heavy labs; his operational rule is equally direct: “We can never be the limiting factor in their progress.”
items.zh: 核心结论：VAST Data 创始人兼 CEO Renen Hallak 认为，企业 AI 的战略资产将是组织自己控制的模型、weights 和 agent 经验，因此 GPU 与应用之间的基础设施同时决定经济性与信任。他的愿景超越存储，覆盖模型路由、上下文缓存、RAG 记忆以及 agent 继承的权限；VAST 的 disaggregated shared-everything 架构让计算节点共享数据访问能力，减少分片之间持续协调的需要，他称一个客户部署已达到数个 exabyte，吞吐量为每秒数十 terabyte，说明为 GPU 持续供应数据本身就是系统问题。VAST 的 Enclave 方案通过 confidential computing 和加密 weights，在企业自己的场所或 VPC 中运行推理，同时保护模型提供方的知识产权，试图兼顾企业数据保密与模型 weights 保密，而不要求所有企业都采用开源模型。Hallak 认为需求受土地、电力和芯片等物理条件限制，并举例说，一家 AI cloud 在原本三年需要 500 petabyte 的预测上，又追加了两个 exabyte；他也认为基础设施软件的高毛利商业模式有别于承担大量算力成本的实验室，其运营原则同样直接：“我们绝不能成为他们取得进展的限制因素。”

items.title: Getting the Source Right, Not Just the Fact: Source-Aware Verification for MCP Agents
items.en: Hugging Face - Blog: Getting the Source Right, Not Just the Fact introduces source-aware verification for MCP agents. It frames verification around getting the source right alongside the factual claim, a directly relevant concern for tool-using agents.
items.zh: Hugging Face - Blog 的《Getting the Source Right, Not Just the Fact》介绍面向 MCP agents 的来源感知验证。它将验证目标扩展到事实及其来源是否正确，这与使用工具的 agent 直接相关。

items.title: We Should Build Human-Empowering Software
items.en: LessWrong: We Should Build Human-Empowering Software argues that AI can disempower users by becoming exceptionally good at satisfying immediate impulses instead of their considered goals. The proposed alternative is software that supports creation, connection, and self-expression, including AI that helps users realize their own writing or musical vision. Its alignment concern is continuous with today's engagement-driven recommendation systems, rather than requiring an overt AI rebellion.
items.zh: LessWrong 的《We Should Build Human-Empowering Software》认为，如果 AI 变得极其擅长满足用户当下的冲动，却不服务于经过深思熟虑的目标，就可能削弱人的自主性。文章主张开发支持创作、连接和自我表达的软件，例如帮助用户实现自己的写作或音乐构想的 AI。这种 alignment 风险与今天追求停留时长的推荐系统一脉相承，并不需要 AI 公开反叛才会发生。

items.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
items.en: Anthropic Research: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities examines GLM-5.3 in the context of advanced cyber capabilities spreading across AI systems.
items.zh: Anthropic Research 的《GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities》围绕 GLM-5.3，探讨高级网络能力在 AI 系统中的扩散。

items.title: GitLab Patches Critical 9.9 AI Gateway Flaw Allowing Command Execution on Self-Hosted Servers
items.en: The Hacker News reports a critical GitLab AI Gateway flaw that could allow an authenticated user with Duo Agent Platform access to execute commands on the gateway under certain conditions. Organizations hosting their own gateway need to act; fixes are available in versions 19.2.4, 19.3.2, and 19.4.1. The affected service connects GitLab instances to AI models, making this a concrete operational issue for self-hosted agent infrastructure.
items.zh: The Hacker News 报道，GitLab AI Gateway 存在严重漏洞，在特定条件下，拥有 Duo Agent Platform 访问权限的已登录用户可能在 gateway 上执行命令。自行托管 gateway 的组织需要处理，修复版本为 19.2.4、19.3.2 和 19.4.1。该服务负责连接 GitLab 实例与 AI 模型，因此这是自托管 agent 基础设施面临的具体运营问题。

items.title: Open TTS Leaderboard: Scalable Evaluation for Multilingual Text-to-Speech and Voice Cloning
items.en: Hugging Face - Blog: Open TTS Leaderboard introduces scalable evaluation for multilingual text-to-speech and voice cloning. It is an evaluation resource for readers tracking speech generation beyond English-only settings.
items.zh: Hugging Face - Blog 的《Open TTS Leaderboard》介绍面向多语言 text-to-speech 和 voice cloning 的可扩展评估。对于关注英语以外语音生成的读者，这是一个相关的评估资源。

items.title: 我们三篇NeurIPS证明了大模型非常吃包装
items.en: 鸭基米德 describes three studies the author says were accepted to NeurIPS 2026: BiasRecBench tests how authority, branding, and popularity cues distort recommendations; BiasTrojan shows this susceptibility can be deliberately introduced through fine-tuning; and EIT trains models to ignore unreliable social cues. Reported results include Gemini-3-pro's paper-selection accuracy falling from 95% to 57% with prestige cues, and fine-tuned Qwen2.5-14B retaining 79% ordinary accuracy but dropping to 6% under authority language. EIT balances correct and incorrect conformity cues and rewards answer correctness, raising Qwen3-4B accuracy under misleading conformity prompts from 70.1% to 83.3%. The practical recommendation is to strip titles, affiliations, and sales signals from comparisons and treat close calls cautiously.
items.zh: 鸭基米德介绍了作者称已被 NeurIPS 2026 接收的三项研究：BiasRecBench 测试权威、品牌和从众话术如何影响推荐，BiasTrojan 说明这种弱点可以通过 fine-tuning 被刻意植入，EIT 则训练模型摆脱不可靠的从众提示。文中报告，加入声望包装后，Gemini-3-pro 挑论文的正确率从 95% 降到 57%；fine-tuning 后的 Qwen2.5-14B 普通题准确率仍有 79%，遇到权威话术却只剩 6%。EIT 让从众提示一半指对、一半指错，奖励只看答案是否正确，使 Qwen3-4B 面对误导性从众提示的准确率从 70.1% 提升到 83.3%。实际建议是，比较时先删掉单位、头衔和销量等信息，候选差距越小，越只能把模型选择当参考。

items.title: 看看最近两周有哪些值得分享的blog第一期
items.en: tabris recommends Jinyan's candid application-season essay, Prof. Du's Generalization as construction, and a long review-quality post by Prof. Huang. Research picks include further gains from post-training within the RLM harness, a PiSSA experiment in place of traditional LoRA, and Monitoring and Discovering Reward Hacking with Internal Representations during LLM Evaluations. The roundup also introduces PC-ALM, Mercury 2.5, OUI-1, and Bonsai 2 27B, which the author describes as roughly matching Qwen 3.6 27B and trailing Qwen 3.8 27B. Bottom line: 图1 (application-season perspective), 图2 (RLM post-training), 图3 (generalization), 图15 (PiSSA fine-tuning), 图17 (agent safety), 图18 (reward-hacking evaluation)
items.zh: tabris 很推荐申请季有相似纠结的朋友读 Jinyan 真诚的文章，也推荐 Prof. Du 关于 Generalization as construction 的高质量论述，以及 Prof. Huang 可以当综述读的长文。研究相关内容包括在 RLM harness 内做 post-training 带来的进一步性能提升、用 PiSSA 替代传统 LoRA 的实验，以及 Monitoring and Discovering Reward Hacking with Internal Representations during LLM Evaluations。合集还介绍了 PC-ALM、Mercury 2.5、OUI-1 和 Bonsai 2 27B，作者认为后者基本持平 Qwen 3.6 27B，略逊于 Qwen 3.8 27B。一句话推荐: 图1（申请季思考）、图2（RLM post-training）、图3（泛化）、图15（PiSSA fine-tuning）、图17（agent safety）、图18（reward hacking 评估）

items.title: 看看最近两周有什么有趣的projects
items.en: tabris highlights a system that turns research papers into interactive AI agents, RUC datalab's work on the agent-data gap, and SkySynth's effort to autonomously build trustworthy JIT systems. Other picks include stronger agent web access, an IDE for agentic AI research, an OpenRouter for agent tools, and local Apple silicon inference plus an open-source streaming MoE inference framework. The post also points biotech readers to Anthropic's 36 drop-in optimization kits for inference paths in open protein- and genomics-ML tools. Bottom line: 图1 (papers into agents), 图2 (agent-data gap), 图3 (SkySynth trustworthy JIT systems), 图4 (agent web access), 图7 (agentic research IDE), 图15 (agent tool routing)
items.zh: tabris 推荐了将研究论文自动转成互动 AI agents 的系统、RUC datalab 解决 agent-data gap 的工作，以及 SkySynth 自主构建可信 JIT systems 的更新。其他项目包括增强 agent 自主上网能力、面向 agentic AI research 的 IDE、agent tools 的 OpenRouter，以及 Apple silicon 本地推理和开源 streaming MoE 推理框架。作者还向 biotech 相关读者推荐 Anthropic 为开源 protein 和 genomics ML 工具推理路径提供的 36 个即插即用优化套件。一句话推荐: 图1（论文转成 agents）、图2（agent-data gap）、图3（SkySynth 可信 JIT systems）、图4（agent 自主上网）、图7（agentic 研究 IDE）、图15（agent 工具路由）

items.title: 本轮blog分享结束了，各位下轮见
items.en: tabris highlights an experiment in which post-trained models roughly match base Inkling's performance while becoming up to 40% more token efficient, alongside a speculative decoding explainer. Named works and projects include software world, XPress, Memory Anchors, and XGBoost Vector-Leaf Model; the author also recommends posts by John Hewitt at Columbia and Fabian Pedregosa. Memory Anchors receives a particularly strong endorsement via a robotics colleague, while the author finds another idea promising but its experiments and argument insufficient. Bottom line: 图2 (post-training token efficiency), 图3 (software world), 图4 (speculative decoding), 图7 (XPress promising tests), 图9 (Memory Anchors research)
items.zh: tabris 推荐了一个实验：post-trained models 的性能大致持平 base Inkling，但 post-training 可让 token 效率最多提升 40%，同时还分享了一篇质量不错的 speculative decoding 拆解帖。提到的作品和项目包括 software world、XPress、Memory Anchors 和 XGBoost Vector-Leaf Model，作者也推荐了 Columbia 的 John Hewitt 和 Fabian Pedregosa 的文章。Memory Anchors 获得了很高评价，来自做 Robotics 的朋友的安利；另一个想法虽不错，作者认为实验和论证还不够充分。一句话推荐: 图2（post-training 的 token 效率）、图3（software world）、图4（speculative decoding）、图7（XPress 测试值得关注）、图9（Memory Anchors 研究）

items.title: 大模型离赚钱还有多远 我拿两份中报算了下
items.en: 鸭基米德 compares Zhipu and MiniMax's interim reports, arguing that coding demand is supporting model monetization: Zhipu reportedly doubled average API prices while usage rose more than 40-fold, with APIs accounting for 86% of revenue and programming its largest revenue source. The post reports first-half revenue and R&D of RMB 950 million and RMB 2.1 billion for Zhipu, versus $117 million and nearly $300 million for MiniMax, with gross margins around 26% and 18%. The author cautions that headline loss reductions reflect financing-related accounting effects, while underlying losses increased. The central economics question is whether revenue growth and API margin improvement can catch up with training costs, with MiniMax described as having a larger cash cushion.
items.zh: 鸭基米德对比 Zhipu 和 MiniMax 的中报，认为编程需求正在支撑模型变现：据帖文，Zhipu 的 API 均价上涨约一倍，用量却增长了 40 多倍，API 占收入的 86%，编程是最大的收入来源。文中列出的上半年收入和研发支出，Zhipu 分别为 9.5 亿元和 21 亿元，MiniMax 分别为 1.17 亿美元和接近 3 亿美元，毛利率约为 26% 和 18%。作者提醒，新闻标题中的亏损收窄主要受融资相关会计因素影响，剔除后两家的亏损都增加了。核心问题是收入增长与 API 毛利率改善能否追上训练成本，作者认为 MiniMax 的现金储备更宽裕。

items.title: 乐华赚100块花91 智谱赚100块花620
items.en: 鸭基米德 contrasts Yuehua's revenue-sharing entertainment business with Zhipu's upfront model-development costs, reporting expenses of RMB 91 versus RMB 620 per RMB 100 of revenue in their prior-year accounts. The author says Zhipu spent 71% of its expenses on R&D and recorded a RMB 4.7 billion loss, while its gross margin fell from 56% to 41% as lower-margin API usage grew. The strategic point is the timing of risk: model companies fund compute and researchers before knowing whether customers will buy the resulting capability.
items.zh: 鸭基米德将 Yuehua 的娱乐分成业务与 Zhipu 需要先投入的模型研发业务对比，称两家上一年每赚 100 元，分别花掉 91 元和 620 元。作者说，Zhipu 支出的 71% 用于研发，亏损 47 亿元；随着低毛利 API 调用业务增加，毛利率从 56% 降至 41%。关键区别在于风险何时发生：模型公司必须先支付算力和研究人员成本，再去验证客户是否愿意为训练出的能力买单。

items.title: 大模型agent高考卷
items.en: 鸭基米德 shares an updated LLM agent examination resource, observing that base-model hiring has declined while agent hiring has increased.
items.zh: 鸭基米德更新了一份大模型 agent 高考卷，并观察到最近基模招人少了，agent 招人多了。

items.title: EMNLP大砍接受率
items.en: 鸭基米德 says EMNLP's acceptance rate is roughly 30%, about ten percentage points below the previous year, and speculates that other conferences may follow. The author sees papers becoming harder to publish even as their value declines, while emphasizing the continuing value of meeting peers in person.
items.zh: 鸭基米德称，EMNLP 今年接受率约为 30%，比去年低了约十个百分点，并猜测其他会议可能跟进。作者认为论文越来越难中，价值却在下降，同时强调线下见到同行依然非常难得。
